name: ION-12310 cloud-sdk 1.0.32 gap-closure for mft-s3-aqua-appia (aw-bridge)
description: Address cloud-sdk-api/aws design gaps identified by aw-bridge-ib and aw-bridge-ob current-state design docs, to unblock their AWS SDK v2 migration. Version bump to 1.0.32-SNAPSHOT. Backward-compatible additive changes only: StorageClient.getMetadata (HeadObject), File+metadata putObject overload, MessagingClient.changeMessageVisibility, receive-with-attributes, S3 event-notification model, batch getParameters. Thorough tests (assertj, mockito, dynamo-integration-test). Design doc at cloud-sdk-api/docs/2026-08-21-cloudsdk-gaps-mft-s3-aqua-appia-design.md. Update README, mvn verify 4 modules, one commit ION-12310 (no push).

entries.summary: Plan: close 6 cloud-sdk-api/aws gaps for aw-bridge migration, additive & backward-compatible, bump to 1.0.32-SNAPSHOT
entries.detail:
Reviewed aw-bridge-ib and aw-bridge-ob current-state design docs in mft-s3-aqua-appia. Gaps to close (all additive/default methods so external implementors and Mockito mocks keep compiling):
G1 StorageClient.getMetadata(bucket,key) -> HeadObject-only metadata read (default falls back to getObject().getMetadata(); S3StorageClient overrides with headObject).
G2 StorageClient.putObject(bucket,key,File,Map,contentType) -> stream-from-disk + user metadata (default falls back to putObject(File); S3StorageClient uses RequestBody.fromFile).
G3 MessagingClient.changeMessageVisibility(queueUrl,receiptHandle,seconds) -> default throws UnsupportedOperationException; SqsMessagingClient overrides via SqsClient.changeMessageVisibility.
G4 ReceiveMessageOptions.messageAttributeNames + messageSystemAttributeNames; wire into SqsMessagingClient receive; QueueMessage.getMessageAttributes() new default (empty) implemented by SqsMessage from message.messageAttributes(). getAttributes() (system attrs) semantics unchanged.
G5 S3 event-notification model in new pkg com.inttra.mercury.cloudsdk.storage.event: S3EventNotification.parseJson(json) using JsonSupport, Jackson-bound records, getUrlDecodedKey().
G6 CloudParameterStore.getParameters(String...) batch with invalid-key fail-fast (default loops getParameter; SsmCloudParameterStore overrides with GetParameters + invalidParameters()).
Tests: assertj + mockito unit tests for each; dynamo-integration-test unaffected. Version bump 1.0.32-SNAPSHOT in root pom dependency.version. README release note. Design doc cloud-sdk-api/docs/2026-08-21-cloudsdk-gaps-mft-s3-aqua-appia-design.md. mvn verify on cloud-sdk-api,cloud-sdk-aws,commons,dynamo-integration-test. One commit ION-12310, no push.
Branch feature/ION-12310-commons-cloudsdk-refactoring. Prior gap wave labeled S-G2 (metadata put/copy overloads) already merged.

entries.summary: Implemented all 6 gaps + tests; api+aws unit tests green (1076/0/0); version bumped to 1.0.32-SNAPSHOT
entries.detail:
Implemented all 6 gaps additively (default methods keep external implementors/mocks compiling):
- StorageClient.getMetadata(bucket,key) default+S3 headObject override; putObject(File,Map,contentType) default+S3 RequestBody.fromFile override.
- MessagingClient.changeMessageVisibility default(throws)+SqsMessagingClient override; ReceiveMessageOptions.messageAttributeNames/messageSystemAttributeNames wired into SqsMessagingClient receive; QueueMessage.getMessageAttributes default(empty)+SqsMessage impl (message.messageAttributes()).
- cloud-sdk-api new pkg storage.event.S3EventNotification (Jackson, parseJson, getUrlDecodedKey).
- CloudParameterStore.getParameters(String...) default fail-fast + SsmCloudParameterStore chunked GetParameters override.
Version bumped root pom dependency.version 1.0.31-SNAPSHOT -> 1.0.32-SNAPSHOT.
Tests: new S3EventNotificationTest, StorageClientDefaultsTest, MessagingClientDefaultsTest, ReceiveMessageOptionsTest, CloudParameterStoreDefaultsTest (api); SqsMessageTest + added nested tests to S3StorageClientMetadataTest (PutFileWithMetadata, GetMetadata) and SqsMessagingClientTest (ChangeMessageVisibilityTests, ReceiveMessageAttributeNamesTests) and SsmCloudParameterStoreTest (batch getParameters). 
mvn -pl cloud-sdk-api,cloud-sdk-aws -am test: 1076 tests run, 0 failures, 0 errors.
